name: codex-auto-resume
description: Resume the exact Codex session that hit a usage limit, once the quota reset time has passed.

interface.shortDescription: Resume a session after a usage limit resets
interface.longDescription: Watches for Codex usage-limit interruptions, records the session id and the reset time Codex reported, and resumes that exact session from a small background helper once the legitimate quota becomes available again. It never rotates accounts, never bypasses limits, and never resumes a session the user cancelled.
